svg.aria-label: Reelax, six production apps (2025 → now). Main engineer on the React Native creator app. Led its move from 0.70 to 0.82 with OTA updates, and built the Next.js marketing site that launched about 70,000 pages in a week. 946 of 950 OTA installs succeeded.
